explanations: In toDto, customFields is a Map cast to Record. The cast only silences the compiler; JSON.stringify serializes a Map as {} because it has no own enumerable properties. Every GET and PATCH response therefore returns "customFields": {} even though the data is stored correctly (patchTicket uses Object.fromEntries for the DB row). It should be Object.fromEntries(ticket.customFields).
fromRow checks the value against PRIORITIES and falls back to "normal" when it is not listed, so the response is 200 with "normal". It does not throw, pass the raw value through, or produce a 422.

applyPatch lowercases each tag and adds it to a Set, so both collapse to a single "billing"; patchTicket spreads the Set into an array. Nothing preserves case, keeps duplicates, or rejects the request.

Object spread is shallow: next.tags would be the same Set instance as ticket.tags, and add/set/delete would alter the input. Copying the collections keeps the original unmodified. Spread does not convert or throw, and the copies have nothing to do with JSON output.
